mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER t USING DUAL ON (t.ORIGIN_URL = #{originUrl}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.TITLE = #{title}, t.CURRENT_PRICE = #{currentPrice}, t.IMAGE_URL = #{imageUrl}, t.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ORIGIN_URL, TITLE, IMAGE_URL, CURRENT_PRICE, START_PRICE, MALL_NAME, COMMUNITY_NAME, LAST_UPDATE_DATE) VALUES (#{originUrl}, #{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{currentPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{mallName}, #{communityName}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DEAL_ID as dealId, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, TITLE as title, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, CURRENT_PRICE as currentPrice, START_PRICE as startPrice, MALL_NAME as mallName, COMMUNITY_NAME as communityName, LAST_UPDATE_DATE as lastUpdateDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC ) WHERE rownum <= 10

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rnum, a.* FROM ( SELECT DEAL_ID as dealId, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, TITLE as title, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, CURRENT_PRICE as currentPrice, START_PRICE as startPrice, MALL_NAME as mallName, COMMUNITY_NAME as communityName, LAST_UPDATE_DATE as lastUpdateDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC ) a WHERE rownum <= #{pageEnd} ) WHERE rnum >= #{pageStart}

SELECT DEAL_ID as dealId, TITLE as title, CURRENT_PRICE as currentPrice, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, MALL_NAME as mallName, START_PRICE as startPrice, LAST_UPDATE_DATE as lastUpdateDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER WHERE DEAL_ID = #{dealId}
SELECT TO_CHAR(REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as REG_DATE, PRICE as PRICE FROM PRICE_HISTORY WHERE PROD_ID = #{dealId} /* 핫딜 상품과 일반 상품의 이력이 같은 테이블을 쓴다면 구분자가 필요할 수 있습니다 */ ORDER BY REG_DATE ASC
